lead: A decision record's `changes:` block needs `modifies:` spelled out even when the record modifies nothing.
body: `conventions.md` § *A decision record* shows both keys under one example that uses both, so a record creating two rules and editing none reads complete without the second — and then `bun nv records --check` refuses it. Write `modifies: []` in the same keystroke as `creates:`, and run `bun nv records --check` beside `bun nv rules --render` rather than after it.
